title: Day and Night 6
content:
Wei Wuxian had spent the whole night teasing Lan Wangji with countless little liberties, growing far too accustomed to the man's quiet compliance. Being caught and held like this threw him off completely.

Lan Wangji’s voice dropped low. “Stop moving.”

Fine droplets of clear water still clung to the sculpted planes of his handsome face, caught on the tips of his pale lashes. His expression seemed carved from ice, yet the heat burning behind his gaze was hot enough to scorch.

Maybe the wine they’d uncorked really had a wicked delayed kick, because Wei Wuxian could feel his head spinning, blood rushing straight to his skull.

“Stop?” he teased. “Why? You let me do whatever I wanted for so long.”

Lan Wangji kept his lips pressed into a bloodless line, refusing to utter a syllable, but his grip on Wei Wuxian’s wrist tightened like a vise. He wasn't budging.

A lopsided smirk pulled at the corner of Wei Wuxian’s mouth. "And what if I don't stop?" he whispered, teasing. "Look at the state of you right now. What are you going to do about it?"

Lan Wangji pinned him with an unyielding stare, a dark spark flaring in the depths of his pale eyes.

That face. That look. The way the air went taut between them. The sheer, overwhelming reality of this man in front of him set off a fuse in Wei Wuxian’s gut, burning through whatever scraps of common sense he had left.

Reason snapped, and Wei Wu Xian lost his mind. Reckless and completely unhinged, he plunged his free hand beneath the surface of the bathwater, brazenly cupping Lan Wangji right between his thighs with a firm, unforgiving grip.

"Come on, Hanguang-jun," he panted out, wild and breathless. "Don't tell me you don't like it when I touch you like this.."
It was like a switch flipped. As if jolted by a sharp shock—or pushed clean past his breaking point—Lan Wangji gave a sudden, terrifying yank. The sheer, overwhelming force dragged Wei Wuxian forward before he could even blink.

Water exploded over the rim, cascading across the floorboards in an absolute deluge.

Neither of them could have said who started it. By the time Wei Wuxian surfaced enough to register reality, he was straddling Lan Wangji’s lap in the bath, their mouths crashing together in a messy, frantic collision of teeth and tongues. They were soaked to the bone, skin sliding against skin, but all he could feel was dry tinder meeting an open flame. A quiet, faint flicker of conscience tried to warn him that this was wrong—that taking advantage of Lan Wangji while he was blackout drunk and lacked basic judgment was completely out of line. The thought was utterly obliterated the second Lan Wangji sucked his lower lip into his mouth, swallowing every gasp of air he had left.

Wei Wuxian twined his arms around the nape of Lan Wangji’s neck, pulling him closer until there wasn't a sliver of air between them. Every neat little lie he’d told himself earlier—I'll just ask him a few questions, I'll just wash his back, I won't do anything else—evaporated into nothingness.

A sharp nip made him pull back with a hiss. "Lan Zhan! What is it with you and biting like a feral dog?!"

Lan Wangji’s answer was to lean in and nip sharply at his chin. Wei Wuxian’s brows twitched—he had zero tolerance for getting bitten, so for payback, he reached down under the water and gave that hard, aching length another firm squeeze.

Lan Wangji’s breath hitched, his composure shattering. Wei Wuxian caught his breath with a breathless laugh, pecking the corner of Lan Wangji’s mouth. "How about that? Hurt? Mad at me?"

He peeled off his soaked top in one fluid motion, tossing it aside. "Lan Zhan, you have no idea.. how much I love it when you're mad..."

He sounded practically intoxicated on his own shamelessness. Lan Wangji’s skin was scorching, burning hot to the touch. Clamping one arm like an iron vice around Wei Wuxian’s waist, he brought his other hand down flat against the wooden rim. The tub splintered with a deafening crack, dumping a wave of water across the floorboards in an absolute disaster.

Neither of them spared it a glance. Lan Wangji practically hauled Wei Wuxian out of the wreckage and shoved him onto the low wooden bed. Wei Wuxian pushed himself up on his elbows only to be pinned flat on his back, the sheer aggression of the shove blowing away any lingering trace of the refined, pristine Hanguang-jun. The hard landing knocked the wind out of him, pulling a low hiss from his lips. Lan Wangji hesitated, his grip faltering for a fraction of a second, but Wei Wuxian just leaned in, murmuring right against his ear: "Who would've thought? You're actually this rough in bed..."

The earlobe brushing against his mouth was pale as jade. Wei Wuxian couldn't resist sinking his teeth into it with a delicate bite, taking the soft flesh between his lips to give it a lazy, wicked suck. Lan Wangji’s hands clamped down over his shoulders with crushing force. The grip was so absurdly tight that Wei Wuxian winced with a sharp intake of air. Peeking sideways, he could already see five bright red bruises blossoming against his skin. Before he could complain, Lan Wangji’s hand had already slid down to his hip.

Wei Wuxian playfully swatted at his wrist with a chuckle. "In a hurry, are we?"

To prove his point, he nudged a knee straight between Lan Wangji’s thighs, brushing against him. Lan Wangji’s pale eyes were rimmed with scarlet, blown wide and dark with desire.

"I never said I wasn't taking them off," Wei Wuxian murmured. "Let me do it."

True to his word, he stripped off his drenched trousers in two rough tugs, bare and unbothered, throwing his arms around Lan Wangji's broad, solid shoulders to pull him down flush against his chest.

Skin slid against bare skin, slick and feverish, their mouths crashing together again in an endless, shifting rhythm. Wei Wuxian tangled his left hand into Lan Wangji’s hair, refusing to give him an inch of breathing room, greedily drinking down his breath and swallowing his spit. His right hand trailed down the clean, powerful contours of Lan Wangji’s back, fingers brushing lightly over the raised ridges of the discipline whip scars with quiet, tender care.

Lan Wangji’s hands were far less delicate. Those long, pale fingers—usually reserved for the refined strings of an ancient guqin—roamed hungrily over Wei Wuxian’s ribs, sliding lower until they gripped his waist and hips with bruising possessiveness. Under those hands, Wei Wuxian was plucked and played, but there wasn't a trace of the detached, aloof master who played Inquiry. And the sounds spilling from Wei Wuxian’s throat weren't clear, ringing notes of an instrument—they were shameless, breathless moans.

At first, Wei Wuxian could ride the high, but soon Lan Wangji’s fingers began kneading the sensitive skin along his inner thighs. The spot was far too tender, and Lan Wangji’s grip was terrifyingly strong. Between the sharp stings and the electric waves of friction, Wei Wuxian found himself squirming, torn between pleasure and ache. He broke the kiss, chest heaving as he pulled at Lan Wangji’s wandering wrist, though he still had enough brass to tease: "Who knew the great Hanguang-jun was this wild once the robes came off? So much for your sacred modesty... ah!"

Lan Wangji pinched down hard right on his nipple. Wei Wuxian arched his back with a sharp gasp, twisting to get away, while a low, dangerous growl rumbled from Lan Wangji’s chest.

"Alright, alright!" Wei Wuxian gave in, catching Lan Wangji’s hand and guiding it lower, guiding it right between his own legs. "Have it your way. Do whatever you want "

Giddy on the rush, Wei Wuxian couldn't help thinking he had an effortless, natural talent for playing the shameless degenerate.

Yet talking a big game was one thing; actually doing it was another. Across two lifetimes, nobody had ever touched him there except his own hand. The moment Lan Wangji’s scorching palm wrapped around his erection, a violent shiver ripped down Wei Wuxian’s spine. He curled his toes, hips hitching involuntarily. But as those broad fingers closed tight, stroking him with a steady, punishing friction, the sheer sensation melted his resistance. Within seconds, his thighs fell slack, opening wider as his arms hooked over Lan Wangji’s shoulders, subconsciously rocking his hips up into the heat of his palm.

Lan Wangji’s strokes turned rapid and demanding. Panting in shallow, desperate bursts, Wei Wuxian’s eyes fluttered shut in pure indulgence, his fingers clawing aimlessly against the firm muscle of Lan Wangji’s back, searching for purchase.

Realizing it wasn't fair for him to be the only one losing his mind, Wei Wuxian slid his right hand downward, brushing between Lan Wangji’s thighs. The moment his fingers closed around the shaft, it gave a heavy, twitching throb, filling his palm with iron-hard, searing heat. The mere contact made Wei Wuxian’s face flame. He had never imagined touching another man like this—the very idea had once seemed inconceivable. But knowing it was Lan Wangji beneath his fingers made a fierce thrill roar in his chest. His grip tightened, frantically stroking the hot length while sliding his bare thigh up and down against it, grinding friction into every movement.

Lan Wangji’s breathing turned ragged and rough, the thick vein running along his shaft throbbing wildly against Wei Wuxian's palm. The heavy air in the room was thick with raw pants, tangled breaths, and the shameless, filthy whimpers slipping past Wei Wuxian’s lips.

Before long, a dizzying tidal wave of pure heat gathered low in Wei Wuxian’s gut, surging through his bloodstream.A lightheaded, tingling numbness washed over him as a thin, weeping whimper broke from his throat. "Lan... Lan Zhan, wait, I—"

The warning came too late. Before he could finish the sentence, the explosive peak hit him like a wave. His breath caught sharply as his mind went completely blank.

When the haze cleared, he blinked down through heavy lashes. Staring blankly at the faint white splatters cooling across Lan Wangji’s taut stomach, he realized he had come—and Lan Wangji had broken at almost the exact same instant.
The hot release coated the skin between Wei Wuxian’s thighs. With the slightest shift of his hips, the sticky mess slowly ran down over his sensitive skin, a stark, slick heat that was impossible to ignore. Looking down wasn't even necessary to know what a disaster the bedding was. The sticky residue felt uncomfortably messy, but riding beneath it was a bone-deep, staggering sense of satisfaction.

Lan Wangji collapsed forward, resting his heavy, warm frame over Wei Wuxian and burying his face into his chest. Wei Wuxian went entirely limp, melted down to the marrow, too blissfully lazy to even twitch a finger. It took a long while for the surging aftershocks to fade and for their breathing to settle into a quiet rhythm.

Pinned beneath that solid weight, Wei Wuxian felt an overwhelming, quiet peace settle over his ribs. He tilted his chin down, pressing soft, lingering kisses into the dark strands of Lan Wangji’s hair. Drifting between them was the faint trace of sandalwood, mingled with the clean, sharp scent of the soapberry they’d just used in the bath. The lingering musk of their release was surprisingly faint.

Wei Wuxian had originally planned on cornering Lan Wangji with questions, but right now, interrogations felt entirely pointless. He could just say it himself.

"Lan Zhan..." he murmured softly. "Are you listening?"

After a pause, Lan Wangji let out a low, muffled "Mm."

Wei Wuxian smiled faintly. "I have something to tell you."

He paused, lowering his voice to a barely audible whisper. "Thank you, Lan Zhan. I..."

If he hadn't crossed paths with Lan Wangji after coming back to life, Wei Wuxian didn't know what kind of state he would be in right now.

Either way, he knew things couldn't possibly be any better than this.

Yet the moment those words left his mouth, Lan Wangji went completely stiff.

Wei Wuxian didn't even notice at first, leaning in to kiss him before continuing, but Lan Wangji suddenly shoved him away and sat up abruptly.

Caught entirely off guard, Wei Wuxian was shoved to the far side of the wooden bed. His back hit the frame with a dull thud, leaving him sitting there dazed, eyes wide in shock. Lan Wangji sat with his head bowed, his chest heaving slightly as he fought for breath.

The two of them sat in dead silence for what felt like an eternity. Lan Wangji was the first to move.

His face was deathly pale, but his eyes were completely, hauntingly sober. He picked up a discarded white robe from the floor and draped it over Wei Wuxian first before searching for his own clothes.

Wei Wuxian could hardly process what had just happened.

It was as if he’d been yanked from a tender, passionate dream straight into a nightmare—a bucket of ice water poured over his head, freezing him to the core. It felt like a brutal slap to the face, leaving his ears ringing and his heart pounding wildly. He sat frozen for a long time, unable to react. When he finally managed to force a sound out, his voice was raspy and raw.

"...Lan Zhan," Wei Wuxian swallowed hard. "Are you... sober now?"

Lan Wangji was already fully clothed, sitting far at the edge of the bed. He pulled his hand across his forehead before turning around. Facing the ruined, waterlogged floorboards, keeping his back firmly to Wei Wuxian, he finally whispered, "...Mm."

Though Wei Wuxian had no idea when Lan Wangji had actually snapped out of his drunkenness, one thing was crystal clear.

For Lan Wangji to react like this the moment he was sober meant only one thing: he had never wanted any of this.

A sudden, sickening realization crashed over Wei Wuxian.

He finally realized just how terrible his actions had really been.
